run_rerank_generate_cli: run the rerank_generate CLI to generate n-best translations using a trained fairseq model
run_gen_and_reprocess_nbest: run gen_and_reprocess_nbest to generate predictions and preprocess them for rescoring with multiple models
run_nbest_generation_with_bpe: run n-best translation generation with BPE tokenization using a fairseq model and beam search
run_preprocess_for_reranking: run preprocess to binarize generated translations for use with rescoring models in noisy channel reranking
run_rerank_with_prefix_constraints: run n-best generation and reranking with target or source prefix length constraints
